scopes.read: Read device state without changing it
scopes.write: Change a device state to a specific value
scopes.toggle: Flip a device between its off and on states

confirmation.prompt_template: Aiko wants to {scope} device '{device_id}' over MQTT. Allow this action once?

tools.name: iot.device.toggle
tools.description: Toggle an allowed smart-home device on or off via MQTT. Requires one-time human approval.

device_id.description: Device id from the configured allowlist (a-z, A-Z, 0-9, _ or -).

tools.name: iot.device.set
tools.description: Set an allowed smart-home device to a specific state via MQTT. Requires one-time human approval.

device_id.description: Device id from the configured allowlist.

tools.name: iot.device.read
tools.description: Ask an allowed smart-home device to report its state over MQTT. Requires one-time human approval.

device_id.description: Device id from the configured allowlist.
